biggest_catch: You claim bookings from a shared pool — popular slots go fast, and idle time earns nothing.
catches: Bookings are claimed from a shared pool; popular jobs go fast and idle time earns nothing.
Pros must pass credential verification and a background check before approval.
Pay is per booking at set rates; cancellations can cost you.
Independent-pro model: you handle your own tools, transport, and taxes.

c1.evidence: Handy's official trust-and-safety page describes the provider path: 'How pros become Handy Approved: We screen handyman and cleaning providers that you book and pay for directly through the Handy platform' — credential verification plus a Checkr background check. The official help center explains: 'When you make a booking, we share it with the network of pros using our platform, and they're able to claim the bookings that suit their preferences.' — a live, provider-owned deal channel across the US, UK, and Canada.

c2.evidence: Official pages publish no fixed pro pay range — pay is per booking; framed as variable.

c3.evidence: Steps follow the official flow: sign up, pass credential verification and background check, get approved, claim bookings that suit your preferences.

c4.evidence: No upfront fee appears on official pages for the pro path.

eligibility: Adults able to pass credential verification and a background check, with cleaning/handyman skills; US, UK, and Canada.
notes: Scenario: local home services. Handy connects screened cleaning and handyman pros with customers: bookings are shared with the pro network, and pros claim the jobs that suit their preferences.
